description: Bitget spot ticker for one pair (e.g. BTCUSDT): last price, bid/ask, 24h high/low, volumes and 24h change, from Bitget's public v2 market endpoint. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bitstamp_tickers when you need Bitstamp spot ticker for one pair: last, bid, ask, 24h; finance_bitfinex_tickers when you need Bitfinex spot ticker for one or more pairs: bid, ask, last. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
